bio: John E. Deaton (born 1967) is an American attorney and political candidate. He was the Republican nominee in the 2024 United States Senate election in Massachusetts and the 2026 United States Senate election in Massachusetts, losing to incumbent Democratic senators Elizabeth Warren and Ed Markey, respectively.
